hangTimeoutMs.label: Silence between chunks
hangTimeoutMs.description: Longest pause allowed once a reply is streaming before the attempt is failed and retried. Raise it for models with long silent thinking phases. 0 turns it off.

wrongProxyEnabled.description: Rewrites every provider’s base URL through the local proxy (default http://localhost:3444/proxy/<host><path>). openai-codex is excluded; it talks to the ChatGPT backend directly. Applies to the next request.

wrongProxyUrl.label: Proxy URL
wrongProxyUrl.description: Where the proxy daemon listens. Its /api/health is probed; an unreachable daemon turns rewriting off until it answers again.

hqEnabled.description: Publish this client’s sessions to WrongStack HQ.

tgLongToolMs.description: Notify when a tool runs longer than this. 0 turns it off.

tgPollIntervalSec.label: Telegram polling interval
tgPollIntervalSec.description: Seconds between Telegram polls. Lower is more responsive but makes more API calls.

tgChatId.label: Telegram notification chat
tgChatId.description: Default chat ID for notifications. A positive ID pairs your private chat with the bot; group IDs (negative) are refused unless allowGroupChats is enabled in the config. Leave empty to clear.

bulk.nested: Items inside a selected folder are included with that folder.
bulk.destination: Destination folder (project-relative; empty is the project root)
bulk.renameHelp: Literal text in each name is replaced; folders stay where they are. An existing item with the new name is never overwritten: that rename fails and is reported.
bulk.deleteHelp: Selected folders are deleted with their contents. Each item is deleted separately; the result lists any that fail.
bulk.unsaved: Save or close edited files first: {{paths}}.
bulk.copyAtomic: Every item is copied from its saved version, or none is: the engine copies them beside their targets first and moves them into place only when all are complete. An existing file or folder with the same name is never overwritten. Folders that contain symbolic links are refused, and one copy is limited to 5,000 entries and 256 MiB.
bulk.copyText: Text files are copied from their saved version; an existing file or folder with the same name is never overwritten. A folder is copied only when all of its listed files are text (at most 200 files, 8 MiB); otherwise nothing of it is copied. Hidden entries, skipped folders such as .git and node_modules, and symbolic links to files are not listed by the engine and are not copied.
bulk.intoItselfCopy: A folder cannot be copied into itself: {{paths}}.
bulk.intoItselfMove: A folder cannot move into itself: {{paths}}.
